name: Little Tree | 200mg Hash Rosin Gummies | Blue Watermelon
description:
10 Gummies | 20MG Each | Solventless Hash Rosin

Bold. Consistent. Adventure-Ready.

Our Blue Watermelon Hash Rosin Gummies are crafted for those who crave a juicy blend of cool watermelon and vibrant berry. Infused with solventless hash rosin for a clean, full-spectrum high, each gummy delivers 20MG of precisely dosed potency—ideal for staying creative, uplifted, and present in the moment.

With a refreshing flavor profile and smooth, balanced texture, these gummies offer a signature Little Tree experience you can count on.

Whether you're out for a long walk or winding down with friends, this gummy keeps you grounded and going.
